releaseNotes:
FFS 1.1.1 — Capture, updates & stability

• More reliable bank notification capture (Wallet, Capitec, Discovery amounts)
• Bank icons on Accounts and Banks & sources
• In-app update prompt with download progress and installer
• Faster, more stable startup (fewer freezes on open)
• Transactions back goes to Home like other tabs
• “Set up notification capture” only shows when access isn’t allowed yet

Local-only. Internal testing build.
